acceptanceCriteria: A valid repository-bound successor with archived manifest and confirmed close decision removes only its predecessor from pending-close readiness.
Missing, foreign, malformed, stale, or unclosed successor evidence remains a readiness blocker.
The recovery decision and predecessor archive bytes remain append-only and unchanged.
Regression tests cover valid successor, incomplete successor, and repository isolation.
Three-language workflow documentation explains validated successor readiness and fail-closed boundary.
goal: Make recovery successor completion a validated, auditable readiness transition while retaining fail-closed behavior for incomplete or invalid successor evidence.
intent: Ensure repository readiness recognizes a valid closed recovery successor and does not leave its archived predecessor blocking new Work Items.
